judgements.reason: Riches like sea-water never satisfy; explains why money hasn't filled the hole.
Brief line on true wealth; too slight for his anger.
About comparing with richer neighbours; not his resentment of the past.
Rich and hungry versus poor and sated; speaks to wealth not satisfying.
Rid yourself of the opinion about poverty; addresses lingering resentment.
Poverty then wealth deceive us; dissatisfaction can also be a blessing.
What you are matters more than what you have; a direction beyond money.
Pain over money is misdirected; turn it toward a higher aim.
What burdened poverty now burdens riches; the malady travels with the person.
Resentment toward a person; his anger is at circumstance.
The whole world weeps with you; shared grief grows lighter.
Describes loss and asks 'what after this?'; offers nothing to hold.
Vivid portrait of grief; restates without consolation.
Those we love stay with us; the past is ours. Consoling, a bit brisk.
Years of mourning, yet God as comfort; grief accompanied by consolation.
Mourn a day or two then be comforted; would feel dismissive to a parent.
Names the fresh wound of loss; nothing beyond description.
Jacob mourns his son and refuses comfort; mirrors grief only.
Death stops the world and raises questions; no comfort offered.
All beings are parted from those they love; you are not alone.
Gratitude for good friends; misses the engagement.
Great rejoicing, like a bride with her jewels; fits the joy.
Joy that great things have been done for me; fits gratitude.
Rejoice, live in peace, God of love with you; warm blessing.
No longing remains unfulfilled; honours years of hoping.
This is what I had long waited for; captures the moment.
Joy of being human in general; not about finding love.
Affection transforms the world; celebrates finding the beloved.
Go out with joy; hills sing. Shares the celebration.
Joy from ethical living; beside the point here.
Love line unrelated to keeping a surprise.
Good things want sharing; relatable but no help holding it in.
Don't reach before it comes; wait your turn. Patience for the moment.
Joy before, during and after giving; savour the surprise as a gift.
Life is a series of surprises; affirms why waiting is worth it.
Wait till the dish reaches you; light lesson in patience.
Let it die with you, it won't burst you; apt and reassuring.
Delay a pleasure and enjoy the victory of restraint.
Talk less; conversation coaxes secrets out. Practical for holding it in.
Make the pleasure wait; pride in restraint. Fits lightly.
Watching a child fall while learning; joy carries them. Speaks to the parent.
Mostly about boredom; only the last line touches failure.
Struggle gets somewhere; too brief and general.
Nestlings learn to fly bit by bit; growth through trying.
Implies the parent provokes the child; unfair and off-target.
We grow wiser through failure; supports what the parent knows.
About guiding a child by shared view; not the pain of watching.
Failures are life's beauty; try again. Reassures about the son's struggles.
Whether to keep striving; loosely related.
Bear patiently what you can't fix in others; fits the parent's helplessness.
Pull yourself from the pit; only a playful word match.
Annoyance isn't injury, but scolds about luxury; slightly heavy.
About merriment and sorrow; off-topic.
Hunted fox fable; unrelated.
Puppies' play does no harm; struggles are play. Lightens the frustration.
Repeated failure with joy; a stretch for a dog in a pool.
Small annoyances swell when brooded on; take it calmly.
Put up with annoying traits or break off; awkward for a pet.
Caring for animals; loosely related only.
Clinging to failing pursuits; unrelated and heavy.
Body and mind need rest or lose power; validates exhaustion, points to rest.
Rest in quiet, don't weary the body; a way to recover.
Describes leaden weariness; restates without help.
Weary and weak in spirit; mirrors only.
Work harder at meditation for rest; odd advice for the exhausted.
Rest belongs to work like eyelids to eyes; gentle permission to rest.
Rest and pause are indispensable; affirms the need to stop.
Strength dried up, brought to dust of death; restates and darkens.
Near collapse, he found inner strength and rose; hope through exhaustion.
Worn out toil then death; bleak echo of 'could just die'.
Weary collapse onto bed; heavier than a day in heels.
Toil without rest kills; too grave for sore feet.
Life's grim wear and death; far too heavy for a light complaint.
Tired from a hard journey; nothing is heavy if taken lightly. Apt and light.
Day's work done, let me rest and dream; gentle end-of-day fit.
Exhausted traveller renewed by night; a tender note on rest.
Weakness from great terror; wrong tone for tired feet.
Rest belongs to work; fitting permission to put feet up.
Pause is indispensable; generic for this moment.
Hidden inner ulcer and self-condemnation; unrelated and heavy.
